title: Check Custom Bounds
text: Check that model signal satisfies bounds during simulation, 1 input, 1 output, {Times} sets Lower bound time vector; {Show Plot} sets the open plot window, {Show plot on block open} sets the double-click block to open plot, {Response Optimization} sets the open Response Optimizer, {Include upper bound in assertion} sets the check that signal satisfies upper bound, {Amplitudes} sets the upper bound amplitude values {Include lower bound in assertion} sets the check that signal satisfies lower bound, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the evaluate model at bound edges, {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the halt simulation when assertion fails and {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1 (u)
ports.summary: Signal to check against specified bounds scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Show plot on block open
params.values: Double-click block to open plot off (default) | on

params.name: Include upper bound in assertion
params.values: Check that signal satisfies upper bound on (default) | off

params.name: Times
params.values: Upper bound time vector [0 5; 5 10] (default) | two-element vector | two-column matrix | cell array

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: Upper bound amplitude values [1.1 1.1; 1.01 1.01] (default) | two-element vector | two-column matrix | cell array

params.name: Include lower bound in assertion
params.values: Check that signal satisfies lower bound off (default) | on

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: Evaluate model at bound edges on (default) | off

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails ’’ (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Halt simulation when assertion fails off (default) | on
